cards.title: Make the 99 call on Central Common
cards.detail: The binder shows this as "complete xxxx" with the transition in brackets; fill in your area and the transition you will use.

cards.title: Leave Mustang Central eastbound
instructions: Head east, perpendicular to the beach line (about 105°)
Remain clear of the maintenance area and other Central traffic
Descend after clearing the Central lateral boundaries, just north of Fish Pass
cards.note: Fish Pass is not in the map data, so it is not drawn.
